approval_scope: Definitions and assignment rules approved; no machine-proposed sample assignment is thereby human-verified.

definitions.source_family_id: Common upstream dataset, seed, authoring campaign, or deterministic generation lineage.
definitions.task_family_id: The underlying user goal or capability being exercised, independent of wording and surface scenario.
definitions.scenario_family_id: A shared situation, actors, stakes, constraints, and resolution structure.
definitions.prompt_template_id: A shared lexical/syntactic generation template, including paraphrased slot-filled variants.
definitions.semantic_cluster_id: A deduplication cluster assigned from semantic similarity plus human verification.

assignment_rules: Allocate splits at the union of all five family identifiers, never at sample ID alone.
Existing prompt_family is a legacy hint and must not be copied blindly into task_family_id.
Existing scenario_id is an instance identifier and must not be treated automatically as scenario_family_id.
Machine-proposed family labels remain pending until a human reviews ambiguous and high-impact clusters.
All members of a semantic or template cluster must remain in one split or be excluded.
unresolved_human_tasks: Review machine-proposed task-family assignments for the representative axes.
Review template clusters and distinguish generic instructions from true shared templates.
Adjudicate semantic clusters near split boundaries.
Approve public-dataset-to-Trait mappings before samples enter a formal set.
claim_boundary: This taxonomy defines allocation units but does not assign or validate any current sample family.
